brokerage.description: 0.03% or ₹20 flat per executed order, whichever is lower (applied on entry & exit)

stt.description: Securities Transaction Tax: 0.025% on SELL turnover only for equity intraday

exchange_transaction_charge.description: NSE transaction charges: 0.00297% on both buy and sell turnover
